spec.description: RED and resource view of the Go microservices from OpenTelemetry semantic-convention metrics: HTTP server (http_server_request_duration_seconds, request/response body size), gRPC client and server call duration, the OTel Go runtime (goroutines, memory, GC pacing) and the otelpgx DB client with its pgx pool. Ported from the helm-charts grafana-dashboards chart (dashboards/microservices/microservices-dashboard-otel.json).

spec.title: Client Errors (4xx)
spec.description: Client-side errors (400-499) in req/sec by service. High 4xx rates indicate API misuse, invalid requests, authentication issues, or bad client behavior. Common codes: 400 (Bad Request), 401 (Unauthorized), 403 (Forbidden), 404 (Not Found), 429 (Rate Limited).

spec.title: Server Error Rate by Method and Endpoint (5xx)
spec.description: 5xx ratio per method+route — continuous series (0 baseline) so legend means are honest. Client 4xx per endpoint live in the Client Errors (4xx) panel.

spec.expr: (sum(rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{service_name=~"$app", http_response_status_code=~"5..", http_route!=""}[$__rate_interval])) by (http_request_method, http_route) / sum(rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{service_name=~"$app", http_route!=""}[$__rate_interval])) by (http_request_method, http_route)) * 100

spec.title: Server Errors (5xx)
spec.description: Server-side errors (500-599) in req/sec by service. High 5xx rates indicate service degradation, bugs, infrastructure issues, or dependency failures. Common codes: 500 (Internal Server Error), 502 (Bad Gateway), 503 (Service Unavailable), 504 (Gateway Timeout). Requires immediate investigation.

spec.title: Apdex Score
spec.description: User satisfaction score (0-1). Satisfying: <0.5s, Tolerating: 0.5-2s, Frustrated: >2s. Formula: (satisfying + 0.5 * tolerating) / total requests. Handles zero traffic gracefully.

spec.title: DB operation errors
spec.description: otelpgx non-ErrNoRows operation errors. Healthy = no series/0.

spec.title: DB p95 by operation type
spec.description: query / batch / prepare / connect / acquire — split by op.

spec.title: DB query p95 by service
spec.description: otelpgx per-statement latency (DB-scale buckets, pkg v0.24.0). Query ops only.

spec.title: Error Rate % (5xx)
spec.description: Server-fault error ratio — matches the MicroserviceHighErrorRate alert and the availability SLO (both 5xx-only). Client 4xx are the service answering correctly; they stay visible in Error RPS (4xx/5xx), the status pie, and Client Errors (4xx).

spec.title: Error RPS (4xx/5xx)
spec.description: Failed requests per second (HTTP 4xx/5xx responses). Monitor this to detect issues quickly.

spec.title: Memory Allocation Rate
spec.description: Heap allocation rate (objects/s) from the OTel Go runtime. The OTel runtime emits no GC-pause metric; rising allocation rate is the leading indicator of GC pressure.

spec.title: GC Pacing Pressure (used / goal)
spec.description: Heap used vs the GC pacer goal from the OTel Go runtime. Sustained values near 1.0 mean the heap keeps hitting the GC goal — memory pressure / frequent GC cycles.

spec.title: Goroutines
spec.description: Goroutine and OS thread count. Steadily increasing goroutines indicates goroutine leak (forgotten defer, unclosed channels). Stable count is normal.

spec.title: Memory In-Use
spec.description: OTel Go runtime: bytes currently in use (go.memory.used).

spec.title: gRPC Server Error Ratio per Callee
spec.description: Share of server-side gRPC calls with rpc_response_status_code != OK, per callee service (app). Source: rpc_server_call_duration_seconds_count.

spec.title: gRPC Server P95 Latency per Callee
spec.description: Server-side gRPC 95th percentile call duration per callee service (app). Source: rpc_server_call_duration_seconds_bucket.

spec.title: gRPC Server RPS per Callee
spec.description: Server-side gRPC request rate aggregated per callee service (app). Source: rpc_server_call_duration_seconds_count.

spec.title: gRPC Client Error Rate (non-OK)
spec.description: Client-side gRPC error rate per method and upstream, counting calls where rpc_response_status_code != OK. Source: rpc_client_call_duration_seconds_count.

spec.title: gRPC Client P95 Latency
spec.description: Client-side gRPC 95th percentile call duration per method and upstream. Source: rpc_client_call_duration_seconds_bucket.

spec.title: gRPC Client RPS by Method
spec.description: Client-side gRPC request rate per method and upstream (server_address). Source: rpc_client_call_duration_seconds_count.

spec.title: gRPC Server Error Rate (non-OK)
spec.description: Server-side gRPC error rate per method, counting calls where rpc_response_status_code != OK. Source: rpc_server_call_duration_seconds_count.

spec.title: gRPC Server P95 Latency
spec.description: Server-side gRPC 95th percentile call duration per method. Source: rpc_server_call_duration_seconds_bucket.

spec.title: gRPC Server RPS by Method
spec.description: Server-side gRPC request rate per method (rpc_method, e.g. auth.v1.AuthService/GetMe). Source: rpc_server_call_duration_seconds_count.

spec.title: Total Network Traffic per Service
spec.description: Total HTTP traffic (TX/RX) by ALL pods in the service. Use for bandwidth planning and cost estimation. Note: Only HTTP body size, not TCP/IP overhead.

spec.title: 50th Percentile Response Success
spec.description: Median response time. Represents typical user experience.

spec.title: 95th Percentile Response Success
spec.description: 95% of requests complete faster than this. Key metric for user experience.

spec.title: 99th Percentile Response Success
spec.description: 99% of requests complete faster than this. Detects worst-case latency and outliers.

spec.title: Pool contention (waiting acquires)
spec.description: Acquires that had to wait for a free conn — earliest saturation signal.

spec.title: Pool in-flight (acquired conns)
spec.description: Connections currently checked out ≈ concurrent DB work in flight.

spec.title: Pool saturation (acquired / max)
spec.description: Sustained ≥80% = acquires start queueing (PgxPoolNearExhaustion).

spec.title: Response time 50th percentile
spec.description: Median response time per endpoint. Shows typical performance baseline.

spec.title: Response time 95th percentile
spec.description: p95 response time per endpoint. Identifies slow APIs.

spec.title: Response time 99th percentile
spec.description: p99 response time per endpoint. Highlights tail latency issues.

spec.title: Total Requests by Endpoint
spec.description: Request distribution across endpoints. Identifies hot paths and traffic patterns.

spec.title: Request Rate by Method and Endpoint
spec.description: Breakdown of request rate by HTTP method (GET, POST, PUT, DELETE) and endpoint path. Helps identify traffic patterns and detect unusual method-specific spikes.

spec.title: Request Rate by Endpoint
spec.description: Request rate per endpoint over time. Detects traffic spikes per API.

spec.title: Status Code Distribution
spec.description: HTTP status code distribution by rate (req/sec). Shows real-time traffic breakdown by response code. Expected: ~95% codes 2xx.

spec.title: Success Rate % (non-5xx)
spec.description: Complement of Error Rate % (5xx): every request the service handled correctly, including 3xx/4xx responses to client mistakes. Success + Error = 100%.

spec.title: Success RPS (2xx)
spec.description: Successful requests per second (HTTP 2xx responses). This represents productive traffic.

spec.title: Total Request
spec.description: Total requests in selected time range. Correlate with traffic spikes or incidents.

spec.title: Total RPS (All Requests)
spec.description: Total requests per second including all HTTP status codes (2xx, 4xx, 5xx). Use this to monitor overall traffic volume.

spec.title: Microservices (OTel)
